principles.title: It's not what you say, it's how you say it.
principles.why: The same information as a plain text post and as an image gets wildly different engagement. The words don't change; the attention does. Treat formatting as part of the message, not decoration on top of it.
tactics: Default to an image or video. Text-only is the fallback, not the starting point.
One idea per post. If it needs a second idea, that's a second post.
Before posting, ask: would this stop me if someone else posted it?
principles.imagePrompt: The same simple object shown twice side by side: on the left dull, flat and grey; on the right the identical object dramatically lit, saturated and glowing

principles.title: Reuse and repost as much as possible.
principles.why: Original ideas are expensive and most people aren't paying close attention. Something that worked once will usually work again with a small change. Treat every successful post as a template, not a one-off.
tactics: Keep a swipe file of your own winners and revisit it before making anything new.
Rotate the format, keep the message: text, image, carousel, short video.
Cross-post everywhere with small platform-specific tweaks.
principles.imagePrompt: A single stencil or rubber stamp print repeated many times in a grid, each copy a slightly different colour or angle, one copy clearly brighter than the rest

principles.title: Win the first second.
principles.summary: Stop or scroll is decided before anyone reads.
principles.why: The decision to stop happens before the post is read. Lead with the strongest element: the image, the number, the headline. Everything else is only seen if the first second works. Rule one is how you win it; rule two says a hook that worked once will work again.
tactics: Put the payoff first. No warm-up, no context, no 'so I was thinking'.
Make the first frame readable at thumbnail size.
If the hook doesn't land in testing, change the hook before changing anything else.
principles.imagePrompt: A thumb frozen mid-scroll above a phone, one bright vivid frame on screen surrounded by a blur of grey motion
